item.title: Dakara Watashi wa Mahou Shoujo wo Yameta
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yukari
  • 発売日: 2024-11-29
  • スコア: 6.11/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: だから私は魔法少女を辞めた
  • 英語名: Dakara Watashi wa Mahou Shoujo wo Yameta

あらすじ

One day, Torika loses contact with her friend Watanabe-chan.

Following the last message she finds, she heads to the aquarium, only to find that the aquarium has turned into a labyrinth.

While searching for her friend and walking through the labyrinth, she encounters a monster.

The monster suddenly appears, and a strangely dressed woman fights it.

item.description:

  • 英語名: Tenrakugai -Shoujo Isekai Touhontan-

あらすじ

It was a common school rumor.

But that story was… real.

Moka, Midori, and Sayu passed through a door and arrived in another world, it was a world that reminded them of the Middle Ages, like something you’d see in a fantasy movie.

The life in the other world was full of excitement that was different from everyday life, and the three enjoyed it.

item.description:

  • ブランド: Yukari
  • 発売日: 2020-03-27
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 復讐してやる！ ～マーダープリンセス・ナハティガル～
  • 英語名: Fukushuu Shite Yaru! Murder Princess Nahtigarh

あらすじ

The pleasure city of Beverkut, surrounded by high, solid walls, fulfills human desires, including commerce and pleasure.

Where people’s desires gather, money also tends to gather, and so does the ambition to rule it.

In addition to the lord who rules the city of Beverkut, there is a group called “The Organization” that tries to control the city from behind the scenes.

别名

  • カイと夢を見ぬ魔女

あらすじ

“Wait… is this… isekai reincarnation?!”

I woke up in an unfamiliar cave.

As soon as I focused, a status screen appeared before my eyes, along with a list of skills. And then there was the ability I remembered—the power to retry as many times as I wanted, no matter how many times I failed.

The Shrine Princess Green Boar Unit: it consists of the two shrine maidens Shirabe and Tsutsuji as well as a third creature, the guardian spirit boar Eddy. As they engage in exorcism on the daily, they can’t fail but notice that the amount of monsters emerging were steadily decreasing.

  • スコア: 5.89/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夜想噺知夜
  • 英語名: Yasoubanashi Chiya

あらすじ

Fukubu Chiya’s daily life was destroyed when the roof of the library exploded.

A monster called Rekka, who had been sealed away in an old book in the library, was released, blowing the roof off.

Monsters are a dark existence that invade human society.

They attack, eat, rape, and kill people during the night… they are nothing less than humans’ natural enemies.

item.title: Isekai Otegaru Yuusha Konomi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 日本語名: 異世界おてがる勇者 このみ
  • 英語名: Isekai Otegaru Yuusha Konomi

あらすじ

Suddenly, Konomi realizes that she is standing in an unfamiliar space.

As she wonders where she is, a beautiful woman appears before her.

“I am the goddess, and unfortunately you have died.”

However, the goddess tells her to go to the Spring of Time to prepare the holy water necessary to revive her.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yukari
  • 発売日: 2016-07-29
  • スコア: 5.5600000000000005/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 風紀委員 白紗
  • 英語名: Fuuki Iin Shirosa

あらすじ

A delinquent at school was found smoking and was suspended.

Having discovered him smoking the other day, Shirosa was determined to have told on the teachers, and was gang-raped as revenge.

Starting with the gang-rape, Shirosa’s life was transformed into a sex life, and her daily life was hopelessly stained with shame.

As she was subjected to the delinquents’ orders and spent her days being violated, Shirosa told herself to endure the present and return to her previous life.

item.title: Shiro no Shoujo
item.description:

  • 英語名: Shiro no Shoujo

别名

  • 白濁（しろ）の少女

あらすじ

Nakata Orika was enjoying her school life, feeling a little excited with the school festival approaching.

But then, ominous shadows began to loom all around her.

A delinquent student, the student council treasurer, a member of the boys’ basketball team, the swimming club advisor and a molester on the school train.

Each with their own reasons, the dark shadows surrounding her become evil hands and attack Orika and her friends.

item.title: Himemiko Sengetsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yukari
  • 発売日: 2008-09-19
  • スコア: 6.1899999999999995/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫巫女・繊月
  • 英語名: Himemiko Sengetsu

あらすじ

Here comes summer…. I lost my older sister several years ago. My partner asks me, “Do you think of her…?” I’ll never forget it. I can’t forget it. She was everything to me because she always protected me from cruel reality. “I don’t need to remember it.” Yes, there is no need to remember because I still remember everything. “Let’s go, Richard.” I have to understand the meaning of fight. I don’t know yet, but I only fight….
